crossRefs.note: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which…
Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, then he vanished out of their sight.
When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more…
But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.
This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
translations.bsb: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them except Jesus.
translations.kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
translations.asv: And suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
